page.overview:
Who is Nyar?

Nyar (also known as Nyarlathotep) is a fictional entity created by Juan Gotō for his manga series Alicia Y.

Nyar is an avatar of Nyarlathotep, who resembles a dark-skinned man wearing clergy attire. When accompanied by Alicia Y Armitage, he often transforms into a black cat, and can also take the form of the three-lobed burning eye. Nyar has been shown to have several supernatural abilities, including flight and teleportation; however, his powers are limited due to him merely being a projection of a god in this world. In addition to spending time on Earth, he appears to have a secret lair, located in the Cydonia region of the planet Mars.

Thousands of years ago, Nyar was the god worshipped in Egypt, who granted a dying wish to the Great Pharaoh Nephren-Ka, teaching him magic and bestowing him with the power of clairvoyance. Nephren-Ka spent his last days painting future events on the walls of his catacomb, which was concealed in fabric by the priests out of fear, only taking a look into the future little by little. According to Nyar, Nephren-Ka is destined to be resurrected in the future but will suffer in a world where there are no humans left to rule.

In the present day, Nyar took the role of Alicia's guardian after the death of Mr. Whateley, changing her surname to "Armitage" instead of Whateley. At the behest of John Dee, Alicia was trapped underneath a giant star-shaped stone by a descendent of the priests who guarded the catacomb of Nephren-Ka, a woman claiming to be a servant of Nyarlathotep. Soon afterwards, Nyar got into a confrontation with the woman, ultimately killing the self-proclaimed servant by crushing her head. Nyar eventually figured out that he needed the Silver Key to save Alicia, with Randolph Carter arriving for assistance; despite being on bad terms with Nyar, Carter agreed to help due to the dire circumstances.
